parsed.post: Latest run improved val_bpb from 1.0438 to 1.0320 by increasing DEPTH from 4 to 6. Increasing capacity is clearly working. Next, I'll try increasing the ASPECT_RATIO to 64 to further expand model capacity, keeping the improved depth and learning rate settings.
parsed.description: Increasing model capacity by setting DEPTH=6 and ASPECT_RATIO=64 to improve representation power.
